answer: Proof of Personhood via decentralized identity registries functions as a Sybil barrier by anchoring digital agency in cryptographic uniqueness. Much like an ocean of verified nodes, the protocol uses social graph attestations to force a gale of verification costs onto attackers. Each fake identity must navigate a nebula of reputation constraints and stake requirements, making the acquisition of high-entropy credentials prohibitively expensive compared to the marginal utility of subverting the network.
